bounded_hypotheses.claim: The three mobile-specific findings may share a device-routing or responsive-resource branching cause.
bounded_hypotheses.falsifier: A code-level or controlled response experiment shows independent causes for route selection, hero scheduling, and terminal asset selection.

bounded_hypotheses.claim: A broad shared frontend runtime contributes recurring performance debt across Tradernet surfaces.

confirmed_findings.claim: The public chart route returns the Tradernet 404 experience for mobile user-agents regardless of viewport width.
Late discovery of the mobile hero image materially increases LCP; a browser-local preload improved median LCP by 3764 ms (33.13%) in three alternating rounds.
The mobile terminal login page downloads a 346800-byte 2x onboarding image that renders at 0x0 and is not visible.
Desktop and mobile terminal entry request a first-party onboarding.png asset that returns HTTP 404; no visible broken image was established.

passed_checks.claim: For MICEXINDEXCF D1, 137 candles, timestamps, and volumes had zero detected OHLC, length, timestamp, or volume violations.
A trusted visible click changed D1/1440 to H1/60, loaded 698 hourly candles, and preserved zero detected data-integrity violations.
The tested desktop profile already scheduled the exact hero resource early; an extra preload did not improve LCP.

recommended_human_actions: File the mobile chart 404 and mobile hero discovery as separate primary reports.
Attach the hidden mobile asset and missing asset as lower-severity terminal findings.
Keep the shared mobile-branch cause explicitly labeled as a hypothesis.
Run market-open quote freshness, reconnect, and cross-surface consistency experiments in a separate authorized scope.
unknowns: Live quote liveness and reconnect behavior were not assessed during an open market session.
A single approximately 7.48-second chart-visibility observation is not a stable latency verdict.
The console message 'ERROR: No context for render' has no established user impact.
Minute interval label anomalies require a visible-menu confirmation.
verdict_meaning: Present confirmed defects and bounded hypotheses to an authorized human owner; do not execute, publish externally, or claim a security vulnerability automatically.
